nodes.label: User
nodes.detail: Provides the goal and receives the final answer.

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.detail: Chooses the tool and interprets its result.

nodes.label: Tool
nodes.detail: Executes a bounded operation and returns output.

nodes.label: Response
nodes.detail: Summarises the result for the user.

steps.title: Decide
steps.description: The agent interprets the request and selects a tool.

steps.title: Execute
steps.description: The agent invokes the tool and receives its output.

steps.title: Respond
steps.description: The agent turns the tool output into an answer.
